SUPERVISOR CORRECTION: the user caught that the player figure's HEAD is now a featureless egg — you reduced the figure's geometry to save bytes. That is the WRONG lever and it violates GUIDING_LIGHT.

The figure is HIGH-RANK AUTHORED CONTENT — the "soul" you PAY for (the bake lever, used sparingly for the parts where the soul is the point). KEEP its real geometry: the proper head with features, the real V2/Characters3D figure. Do NOT dumb it down.

The size win comes ENTIRELY from FACTORING the LOW-RANK map: (1) RLE the dense MAP lump (the 1.67MB raw grid — that is the bloat), (2) reference shared piece geometry by geom_key instead of embedding per-instance vertices. NOT from cutting the figure's polys.

Restore the figure's real head/geometry. Get the bytes from the map. Don't trade the soul for the skeleton — that's the exact fork the doc warns about. Re-verify: file size still drops (from the MAP RLE), AND the figure looks like /test again.
